```{=html}
<!-- MLSecOps Lab Gameboard -->
<div id="mlsecops-gameboard" class="msl-board">
  <div class="msl-board-header">
    <h2>🎲 Your MLSecOps Lab Journey</h2>
    <p>Roll through 8 stops to ship a secure, production-grade ML system. Click any tile to start that mission. Your progress is saved on this device.</p>
    <div class="msl-progress-wrap">
      <div class="msl-progress-bar"><div class="msl-progress-fill" id="msl-fill"></div></div>
      <span id="msl-progress-label">0 / 8 missions complete</span>
      <button class="msl-reset" id="msl-reset" title="Reset progress">↺ Reset</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <ol class="msl-track" id="msl-track">
    <!-- tiles injected by JS -->
  </ol>

  <div class="msl-legend">
    <span class="msl-chip msl-chip-start">START</span>
    <span class="msl-chip msl-chip-core">Core Mission</span>
    <span class="msl-chip msl-chip-bonus">Side Quest</span>
    <span class="msl-chip msl-chip-finish">FINISH</span>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const TILES = [
    { id: "start",    type: "start",  icon: "🚀", title: "Need for MLOps",          blurb: "Why notebooks ≠ production. Mind the gap.",                              href: "MLOps.html" },
    { id: "resources",type: "bonus",  icon: "🧰", title: "Resources",               blurb: "Python & Git — your everyday tools.",                                    href: "Python.html" },
    { id: "infra",    type: "core",   icon: "🖥️", title: "Infra Setup",             blurb: "GitHub → Azure, Terraform, ML pipeline, data ingestion.",                href: "vc.html" },
    { id: "data",     type: "core",   icon: "📊", title: "Understand the Dataset",  blurb: "Get to know the NYC Taxi data before you model it.",                     href: "dataset.html" },
    { id: "ml",       type: "core",   icon: "🧠", title: "ML Foundations",          blurb: "Supervised + unsupervised, registry, real-time endpoint.",               href: "supervised.html" },
    { id: "monitor",  type: "core",   icon: "📈", title: "Monitoring",              blurb: "Data drift, model drift, alerts, retraining loop.",                      href: "monitoring_maintainance.html" },
    { id: "secure",   type: "core",   icon: "🛡️", title: "Security & Best Practices", blurb: "RBAC, secrets, reproducibility, auditability.",                      href: "security_best_practices.html" },
    { id: "finish",   type: "finish", icon: "🏁", title: "Going Forward",           blurb: "Reflect, level up, and explore advanced topics.",                        href: "going_forward.html" }
  ];

  const KEY = "msl_progress_v1";
  const state = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "{}");

  const track = document.getElementById("msl-track");
  const fill  = document.getElementById("msl-fill");
  const label = document.getElementById("msl-progress-label");

  function render() {
    track.innerHTML = "";
    TILES.forEach((t, i) => {
      const done = !!state[t.id];
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.className = "msl-tile msl-" + t.type + (done ? " msl-done" : "");
      li.innerHTML = `
        <a href="${t.href}" class="msl-tile-link" data-id="${t.id}">
          <div class="msl-tile-step">Stop ${i + 1}</div>
          <div class="msl-tile-icon">${t.icon}</div>
          <div class="msl-tile-title">${t.title}</div>
          <div class="msl-tile-blurb">${t.blurb}</div>
          <div class="msl-tile-cta">${done ? "✓ Completed — Revisit" : "Start mission →"}</div>
        </a>
        <button class="msl-tile-check" data-id="${t.id}" aria-label="Mark complete">
          ${done ? "Mark incomplete" : "Mark complete"}
        </button>
      `;
      track.appendChild(li);
    });

    const done = TILES.filter(t => state[t.id]).length;
    fill.style.width = (done / TILES.length * 100) + "%";
    label.textContent = `${done} / ${TILES.length} missions complete`;
  }

  track.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest(".msl-tile-check");
    if (!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = btn.dataset.id;
    state[id] = !state[id];
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    render();
  });

  document.getElementById("msl-reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    for (const k of Object.keys(state)) delete state[k];
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    render();
  });

  render();
})();
</script>

<style>
.msl-board {
  --msl-bg: #0b1f3a;
  --msl-bg-2: #102a52;
  --msl-accent: #ffb703;
  --msl-accent-2: #fb8500;
  --msl-core: #2a9d8f;
  --msl-bonus: #8338ec;
  --msl-finish: #e63946;
  --msl-text: #f8f9fa;
  --msl-muted: #cfd8e3;

  background: radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 10% -10%, #163766 0%, var(--msl-bg) 60%);
  color: var(--msl-text);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 28px 24px 22px;
  margin: 24px 0 32px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
}
.msl-board-header h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--msl-text); font-weight: 800; }
.msl-board-header p  { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--msl-muted); max-width: 70ch; }
.msl-progress-wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom: 18px;}
.msl-progress-bar { flex: 1 1 240px; height: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius: 999px; overflow:hidden;}
.msl-progress-fill { height:100%; width:0%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--msl-accent), var(--msl-accent-2)); transition: width .4s ease;}
#msl-progress-label { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--msl-muted); }
.msl-reset { background: transparent; color: var(--msl-muted); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25); border-radius:8px; padding:4px 10px; cursor:pointer; }
.msl-reset:hover { color: var(--msl-text); border-color: var(--msl-text); }

.msl-track {
  list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0;
  display: grid; gap: 14px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) { .msl-track { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);} }
@media (max-width: 820px)  { .msl-track { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);} }
@media (max-width: 520px)  { .msl-track { grid-template-columns: 1fr;} }

.msl-tile {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.08), rgba(255,255,255,.03));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
  min-height: 200px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
}
.msl-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25); border-color: var(--msl-accent); }
.msl-tile-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; flex:1;}
.msl-tile-step { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--msl-accent);}
.msl-tile-icon { font-size: 1.8rem; }
.msl-tile-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.msl-tile-blurb { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--msl-muted); flex:1; }
.msl-tile-cta   { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--msl-text); font-weight:600; margin-top: 8px; }

.msl-tile-check {
  position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px;
  font-size: .72rem; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.25); color: var(--msl-text); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}
.msl-tile-check:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.45); }

.msl-start  { border-color: var(--msl-accent); }
.msl-core   { }
.msl-bonus  { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(131,56,236,.18), rgba(131,56,236,.05)); }
.msl-finish { border-color: var(--msl-finish); }

.msl-done { outline: 2px solid var(--msl-core); }
.msl-done .msl-tile-cta::before { content: "✓ "; color: var(--msl-core); }

.msl-legend { display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:16px; }
.msl-chip {
  font-size:.72rem; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); color: var(--msl-muted);
}
.msl-chip-start  { color: var(--msl-accent); border-color: var(--msl-accent); }
.msl-chip-core   { color: var(--msl-core);   border-color: var(--msl-core);   }
.msl-chip-bonus  { color: #c5a3ff;           border-color: var(--msl-bonus);  }
.msl-chip-finish { color: #ffb1b8;           border-color: var(--msl-finish); }
</style>

```
